title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper
description: Extract reviews from Trustpilot company review pages. Add one or more Trustpilot review URLs or company domains.

urls.title: Trustpilot URL or company domain
urls.description: Trustpilot company review URLs or plain company domains. Examples: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/apify.com or apify.com.

results_wanted.title: Reviews wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to save across all URLs. Values above about 200 are collected automatically across multiple review views.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages per filter
max_pages.description: Maximum review pages to request per filter view. Trustpilot serves at most 10 anonymous pages (about 200 reviews) per filter view.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Use all languages or a Trustpilot language code such as en, de, fr, es, or it.

stars.title: Star rating filter
stars.description: Optional star rating filter from 1 to 5.

verified.title: Verified reviews only
verified.description: Return only verified reviews when enabled.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Uses no proxy by default. Choose Apify Proxy or provide custom proxy URLs for reliable extraction at scale.
